$comment: Dashboard strings of the new-exam wizard (WP 1.3): 0.4, 0.2, 0.2a, E.1, 0.3, 0.3a, 0.3b and 0.5, plus 0.1's New exam. English comes from the Figma frames; keys without a Figma source are listed in docs/decisions.md under 1.3 Exam wizard. The Russian is a first pass by the agent: native review needed, P.18.
